parameters.query:
SELECT 
  COALESCE((SELECT valor FROM config WHERE clave='meta_access_token'), '') AS meta_token,
  COALESCE((SELECT valor FROM config WHERE clave='groq_api_key'), '') AS groq_token,
  COALESCE((SELECT valor FROM config WHERE clave='ycloud_webhook_secret'), '') AS ycloud_secret

UPDATE mensajes SET estado=$1,wamid=COALESCE($3,wamid)
WHERE direccion='out' AND (proveedor_id=$2 OR wamid=$3) RETURNING wamid,estado
SELECT ycloud_reclamar($1::bigint,$2) AS data, $3::integer AS intento
